_readme: Token tree build_tokens.py reads. Each leaf is {type, value, source}. Values were read from understory.io on 2026-11-21: declared :root custom properties in raw/css-vars.json, and computed styles in raw/components-computed.json. One light theme on the marketing site. Unread states are not filled in.

core.$description: Scales and the brand palette declared on :root.

moss.source: declared --moss on :root (raw/css-vars.json); computed color of body and background of a.button-n Try for free (raw/components-computed.json)
moss.description: The house green. Text, primary button fill, and the ink of headings.

darkMoss.description: A darker moss declared on :root. Not seen as a computed fill on the captured marketing controls.

muted.source: computed color of .text-color-green (rgb(124, 144, 125)) on the homepage eyebrow (raw/components-computed.json). Not a declared custom property.
muted.description: Secondary green used for small labels. Measured, not a named --variable.

page.source: computed backgroundColor of body (rgb(246, 244, 232)), class background-color-beige (raw/components-computed.json). Not equal to --beige or --light-grey.
page.description: The painted page ground. Slightly lighter than the declared --beige.

card.source: computed backgroundColor of .plan-card on /pricing (rgb(234, 232, 221)) (raw/pricing-extra.json). Equals declared --beige-new.
card.description: Plan card fill. Same hex as beigeNew.

citrus.description: The yellow accent declared on :root. Used on promo pills; not the primary button.

white.source: declared --white on :root (raw/css-vars.json); computed color of a.button-n primary label

sans.source: computed fontFamily of body, buttons, nav, fields (raw/components-computed.json); @font-face Inter from the Webflow CDN

display.source: computed fontFamily of h1 and h2 (raw/components-computed.json); @font-face National 2 Condensed bold and regular

editorial.source: computed fontFamily of the homepage step heading (class heading-style-h5 font-alternate) (raw/components-computed.json); @font-face Ppeditorialnew

regular.source: computed fontWeight of the editorial step heading

book.source: computed fontWeight of body and nav labels. Inter variable axis, not a CSS keyword.

bold.source: computed fontWeight of h1 and h2

$extensions.source: computed style of h1.heading-style-h1 on / at 1440 (raw/components-computed.json). text-transform uppercase is not a DTCG typography field; recorded in $description.

display.$description: 63.75/63.75 National 2 Condensed bold, uppercase. Desktop h1.

$extensions.source: computed style of h2.heading-style-h2 on / at 1440 (raw/components-computed.json)
computed style of the Step 1 heading (heading-style-h5 font-alternate) (raw/components-computed.json)

body.$description: 13.5/20.25 Inter at weight 450. The site's body size.

$extensions.source: computed style of .text-size-small.text-color-green (raw/components-computed.json). letter-spacing rounded from -0.26256px.

caption.$description: 10.5/13.65 Inter, slightly tight tracking, muted green.

none.source: computed borderRadius of h1, body, fields (raw/components-computed.json)

token.source: declared --border-radius on :root (raw/css-vars.json). 0.75rem at the 13.5px root is 10.125px, which is not the 9px button radius.
token.description: The declared radius token. Buttons do not use it; they are 9px.

button.source: computed height of visible a.button-n Try for free and Login (raw/components-computed.json)

none.source: computed borderTopWidth of body, h1, buttons, nav (raw/components-computed.json). Edges are fills, not strokes.

desktop.source: requested and measured viewport width of the desktop captures (raw/components-computed.json viewport.w)

phone.source: requested viewport width of the phone captures

light.$description: The one theme the marketing site paints. Roles alias the palette.

primary.source: computed color of body and h1 (raw/components-computed.json)

default.source: declared --beige-gray and --_confirm-step---step-border (raw/css-vars.json). Captured controls mostly have a 0px border.

primary.source: computed backgroundColor of a.button-n (Try for free) (raw/components-computed.json)

primaryText.source: computed color of a.button-n (Try for free) (raw/components-computed.json)

secondary.source: computed backgroundColor of a.button-n.is-lightgreen (Book a demo) (raw/components-computed.json)

danger.source: declared --red on :root (raw/css-vars.json). A live error state was not shown; the role is the declared token only.
